root_causes.teardown_mislabel: real-provider initialized tree_gone=null and only set it AFTER the teardown block; an early ACTIVATION_REFUSED left it null. harness.mjs:219 treated (REAL && tree_gone==null && provider_outcome) as HELD_TEARDOWN_DEFECT — mislabeling a pre-spawn PROVIDER failure as a teardown defect.
root_causes.tree_gone_null: tree_gone was a nullable field with no explicit not-attempted state; an early return never reached the teardown check.
root_causes.terminal_mapping: supervisor-main had no case for final_state STOPPED_TEARDOWN_DEFECT and defaulted to STOPPED_EXHAUSTED, exposing a HELD run as clean queue exhaustion.

corrections.teardown_authority: real-provider now carries teardown_status (never null): TEARDOWN_NOT_ATTEMPTED (init/early return) / TEARDOWN_CONFIRMED (tree gone) / TEARDOWN_UNKNOWN (unchecked) / TEARDOWN_FAILED. Success requires the tree confirmed gone; UNKNOWN fails closed.
corrections.provider_failure_vs_teardown: harness distinguishes a genuine teardown defect (tree_gone===false OR teardown_status FAILED/UNKNOWN) from an early provider failure (HELD_PROVIDER_FAILURE). A pre-spawn refusal no longer maps to a teardown defect. provider_invocation lifecycle recorded (NOT_ATTEMPTED/SPAWN_ATTEMPTED/SPAWNED/OUTPUT_RECEIVED).
corrections.terminal_mapping: supervisor-main uses an EXHAUSTIVE mapping: held/defect/provider-failure/unknown terminals map to HELD (unknown fails closed); ONLY a clean STOPPED_EXHAUSTED with a non-held outcome maps to STOPPED_EXHAUSTED. No default fall-through.
corrections.witness: health-witness reads the supervisor state; a HELD teardown/provider terminal now surfaces as HELD, never COMPLETED_HEALTHY.
corrections.leaked_worktree: the exact empty leaked worktree (…-worktrees/lrcq-first-internal-5h-run, unregistered, 0 files, no unique work) was removed with a receipt; raw REAL-RUN evidence preserved.
